worldcombat.skill.watergun.summary: A thin, fast line of water fired straight at the target: short wind-up, short cooldown, fired while moving - the handy poke of a close fight. Charge form swaps it for a heavier slug at the cost of speed, range and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.watergun.use.0: Keep poking while running in a close fight
worldcombat.skill.watergun.use.2: Chip with a cheap shot before a heavier move
worldcombat.skill.watergun.description.0: Fires a line of water at the target for %1$s power.
worldcombat.skill.watergun.description.1: Projectile speed: %1$s blocks per tick. Hit radius: %2$s blocks. Range: %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.watergun.charge.on: Charge form: line power x1.28 and radius x1.25, at the cost of jet speed x0.85, range -2 blocks, wind-up +4 ticks and cooldown +8 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.watergun.charge.off: Rapid form: faster jet, range +2 blocks, shorter wind-up and cooldown, but each shot is only about four fifths of the charge form's power.
worldcombat.skill.watergun.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.watergun.growth.0: From level %1$s the line power rises to %2$s and the range to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.watergun.growth.1: From level %1$s the line power rises to %2$s and the splash grows to %3$s droplets.
worldcombat.skill.watergun.preference.ch: On: line power x1.28 and radius x1.25, for dropping low-defence targets; costs jet speed x0.85, range -2 blocks, wind-up +4 ticks and cooldown +8 ticks. Off (rapid form): faster jet, range +2 blocks, shorter wind-up and cooldown, but each shot is about four fifths of the charge form's power.
worldcombat.skill.watergun.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: low-health targets rank higher so the cheapest shot finishes them, saving PP for heavier moves; off: all targets score the same.
